patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lusha and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lusha and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Lusha only if your buying job matches “B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and” rather than Salesloft's shape. Choose Salesloft only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, seque” rather than Lusha's shape. Workflow advantage: Lusha leans contact-management; Salesloft leans sales-engagement, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Lusha and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Lusha is B2B data intelligence platform for verified contact/company data, enrichment, signals, and Engage outreach sequences.; Salesloft is Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, sequencing, coaching; talk-to-sales pricing..
- Workflow coverage skew: Lusha-leaning contact-management vs Salesloft-leaning sales-engagement, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Lusha — Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.; Salesloft — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core.

Limitations — Lusha: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.; Credit-based consumption for reveals/signals/API; unused annual credits do not roll over.; Salesloft: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — talk-to-sales only.

Poor-fit cases: Lusha is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene. · Salesloft is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · Avoid Lusha if you actually need Salesloft's motion (Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM s)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
